findings.problem: 'ô này tạm dừng' attaches the pause verb to a text box with no state marker; every paused state in the approved vi corpus carries đã/đang ('Đã tạm dừng', 'Thao tác này đang tạm dừng.'). Meaning is not lost and the reader still sees the box is unusable, so this is polish, not a defect.
